about: Software tester who treats quality as a shared responsibility rather than a final gate. Over the past several years I have built a habit of asking the awkward questions early, automating the tedious checks, and keeping a close eye on the edges where defects love to hide.
job_expectations: Looking for a senior testing role on a product team that values early involvement, strong automation, and close collaboration with developers.
hobbies: Trail running, cryptic crosswords, and tinkering with retro electronics.

experiences.description: Lead testing strategy for a multi-team product, combining exploratory testing with a growing automation suite. Embed quality practices into the delivery process and mentor newer testers. Work closely with developers to catch issues long before release.

Designed and maintained automated regression suites for a complex enterprise application. Partnered with cross-border teams to clarify requirements and reproduce defects. Improved test coverage and reporting visibility for stakeholders.

Performed functional and exploratory testing across web and desktop products. Wrote detailed defect reports and collaborated with developers to confirm fixes. Began building automated checks for repetitive test scenarios.

projects.title: Heavy Machinery Control Validation
projects.summary: Built and executed a testing program for a desktop control application used in heavy machinery manufacturing. Focused on boundary conditions and failure modes that mattered most on the factory floor. Reduced escaped defects through structured exploratory sessions.

projects.title: Biotech Data Integrity Verification
projects.summary: Led testing for a biotechnology data platform with strict integrity and security requirements. Validated complex workflows and probed for vulnerabilities alongside the security team. Helped ensure reliable behavior under unusual data conditions.

projects.title: Legal Workflow Assurance Suite
projects.summary: Owned quality verification for a corporate counsel workflow application. Designed test cases covering intricate approval paths and edge scenarios. Collaborated with developers to harden the platform ahead of each release.
